_key.description: SHA-256 hash of the two Ensembl mouse gene IDs together with the supporting PubMed IDs.

_from.description: Handle of one mouse gene in the genetic interaction.

_to.description: Handle of the other mouse gene in the genetic interaction.

detection_method.title: Detection Method
detection_method.description: PSI-MI detection method used to observe the interaction

enum_descriptions.genetic interference: This term refers to methods that aim at interfering with the activity of a specific gene by altering the gene regulatory or coding sequences. This goal can be achieved either by a classical genetic approach (random mutagenesis followed by phenotype characterization and genetic mapping) or by a reverse genetics approach where a gene of interest is modified by directed mutagenesis.

detection_method_code.title: Detection Method Code
detection_method_code.description: PSI-MI identifier of the detection method.

enum_descriptions.dosage rescue (sensu BioGRID): Increased dosage of one gene rescues lethality or a growth defect associated with perturbation of another gene.
enum_descriptions.negative genetic interaction (sensu BioG: Genetic perturbation of multiple genes in combination that results in a more severe phenotypic defect (or lethality) than from individual viable perturbations. This term is reserved for high throughput studies with scores.
enum_descriptions.phenotypic enhancement (sensu BioGRID): Genetic perturbation of multiple genes in combination that results in a more severe phenotype (except lethality or growth defect) than individual genetic perturbations.
enum_descriptions.phenotypic suppression (sensu BioGRID): Genetic perturbation of one gene suppresses a phenotype (other than lethality or growth defect) associated with perturbation of another gene.
enum_descriptions.positive genetic interaction (sensu BioG: Genetic perturbation of multiple genes in combination that results in a less severe phenotype than from individual perturbations. This term is reserved for high throughput studies with scores.
enum_descriptions.synthetic growth defect (sensu BioGRID): Mutation of multiple genes in combination that results in a more severe growth defect than from individual mutation.
enum_descriptions.synthetic haploinsufficiency (sensu BioG: Genetic perturbations of multiple genes in combination that results in a more severe growth defect than each individual perturbation, when one mutation is hemizygous.
enum_descriptions.synthetic lethality (sensu BioGRID): Mutation of multiple genes in combination that results in lethality when individual single mutations are viable.
enum_descriptions.synthetic rescue (sensu BioGRID): Mutation of one gene rescues lethality or a growth defect associated with perturbation of another gene.

confidence_value_biogrid.title: BioGRID Confidence Value
confidence_value_biogrid.description: BioGRID confidence score from the merged table. Null when the source has none. Larger values mean higher reported confidence.

confidence_value_intact.title: IntAct Confidence Value
confidence_value_intact.description: IntAct MIscore from the merged table, on a 0–1 scale. Null when the source has none. Larger values mean more supporting evidence.

z_score.title: Z-Score
z_score.description: Coexpression z-score placeholder for BioGRID interactions.

enum_descriptions.0: No COXPRESdb coexpression z-score is available; this value is a placeholder.

molecular_function.title: Molecular Function
molecular_function.description: Gene Ontology term for protein binding, as a handle into ontology_terms.
